title: Genome-wide association analyses identify 44 risk variants and refine the genetic architecture of major depression
authors: Wray NR, Ripke S, Mattheisen M, et al., Henders AK, et al.
abstract: We conducted a meta-analysis of genome-wide association studies (GWAS) of major depression, identifying 44 independent and significant loci.

title: The Australian Genetics of Depression Study: Study Description and Sample Characteristics
authors: Byrne EM, ..., Henders AK, Wray NR, Martin NG
abstract: The Australian Genetics of Depression Study was established to identify genetic and environmental factors associated with depression and treatment response.

title: Genetic architecture of human cortical thickness
authors: Grasby KL, Jahanshad N, Painter JN, ..., Henders AK, et al.
abstract: Here we report a meta-analysis of GWAS of cortical thickness and surface area in 33,992 individuals of European descent.

title: The Queensland Twin Adolescent Brain (QTIM) Study
authors: Wright MJ, Ames D, ..., Henders AK, et al.
abstract: A longitudinal study to understand the genetic and environmental influences on brain structure and function during adolescence.

title: Epigenome-wide association study of body mass index, and the adverse outcomes of adiposity
authors: Wahl S, Drong A, Lehne B, ..., Henders AK, et al.
abstract: We identify and replicate 187 genetic loci with differential DNA methylation associated with BMI, shedding light on the metabolic consequences of adiposity.

title: Large-scale collection of biospecimens in a geographically dispersed population: best practices
authors: Henders AK, Wallace L, ..., Wray NR
abstract: An overview of the logistical and operational frameworks required to collect, process, and store biospecimens safely from across Australia.
